title: Public source discovery job
purpose: Scan blueprint-defined public source families for candidate source records without storing raw source bodies.
privacy_rule: Discovery jobs emit metadata pointers and license notes only.

title: Public source snapshot job
purpose: Capture or locate source snapshots and archive pointers with content hashes and retrieval timestamps.
privacy_rule: Snapshots must respect source licensing and tenant privacy boundaries.

title: Public source conversion job
purpose: Convert captured public pages, PDFs, forms, or notices into Markdown with source spans and conversion warnings.
privacy_rule: Do not convert private source bodies in public catalog jobs.

title: Public source ingest job
purpose: Extract normalized candidate objects from converted source material according to blueprint extraction contracts.
privacy_rule: Extract only redistributable metadata or tenant-bound private objects according to policy.

title: Public source dedupe index review chain
purpose: Link entities, dedupe candidates, emit search/index rows, and open review tickets for high-risk or volatile outputs.
privacy_rule: Review jobs should reference object IDs and evidence spans, not leak private source text.
